About this item

  • RGBICWW Technology & Upgraded Illumination: Enjoy multi-color displays, 500lm brightness (higher than previous models), and adjustable 2700k-6500k warm/cool whites. With Upgraded Illumination and Design, a pure visual feast whenever the smart table lamp is turned on.
  • Newly Preset Modes: With 64+ diverse preset scenes and 8 music syncing modes, this smart table lamp can enrich your party experience, immersing yourself in relaxation or entertainment moments.
  • Matter Suppported: Beyond Alexa, Google Home, and SmartThings, the bedside lamp supports HomeKit via Matter. Seamlessly control your entire smart lighting setup with a single voice command.
  • Newly Pat-to-Wake Mode: A new wake-up way to illuminate your room with just one pat, for turning the RBGIC table lamp on easily at night when light is needed. (Requires Turn on The "Bedtime Switch" in the App first & Only Support Turn on)
  • DIY Creation Supported: This smart night light supports fun and sharable DIY customized lighting effects with the App so that children expand their imagination and adults create brilliant surprises for parties and anniversaries.
  • More Considerate Functions: This Govee table lamp also supports timer and schedule settings, which makes your life more worry-free. (Note:‎The Power Source is Corded Electric)

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    An adult lava lamp!
    The Govee RGBIC Smart Table Lamp 2 is one of the coolest products I’ve purchased in a long time. I wasn’t sure if I’d like it, but as soon as I plugged it in, I was impressed! It reminds me of an adult lava lamp with a modern, sleek design. The lighting effects are beautiful, and there are so many color combinations and scene settings to choose from. Whether you’re gaming, relaxing, or just want to add some ambiance to a room, this lamp is a fantastic addition. Color changes are smooth and calming. It’s a plug-in lamp (not battery-operated), and it’s the perfect size, not too big or bulky. It’s compact enough to tuck away if you want, but the design is so sleek that it looks great sitting out on display. I definitely recommend it!

      The Govee RGBIC Smart Table Lamp 2 has been another great addition to my growing Govee ecosystem. I bought it for my home office desk, and it fits the space perfectly.

      The lighting is bright, vibrant, and easy to customize. I like being able to switch between clean white light while I’m working and colorful lighting when I’m gaming or just relaxing. The RGBIC effects look fantastic, and the app makes it simple to create different scenes and automations.

      Since I already have several Govee products throughout my home, this lamp integrated seamlessly into my existing setup. Everything works together flawlessly through the Govee app, making it easy to control all of my lighting from one place.

      The build quality feels premium, and the modern design looks great on my desk without taking up much space. If you’re already invested in the Govee ecosystem—or you’re looking for a high-quality smart desk lamp—this is an easy recommendation. It’s been one of my favorite additions to my home office.

      I already own a few Govee products, so I decided to give this smart bedside lamp a try. I really needed a new bedside lamp, so I figured I’d test it out—and I’m so glad I did. I ended up loving it.

      The brightness is excellent. It can get very bright at 100%, but you can also dim it down as much as you want, which is perfect for nighttime use. I was pleasantly surprised by how many different settings it has. I’ve used the Govee app before with my monitor backlight, but the features on this lamp feel completely different and much more immersive.

      There are so many fun modes—like fire-like flames, fireflies floating around, night sky effects, and soothing ambient lights. One of my favorite features is that you can actually draw in the app and have your drawing show up on the lamp. It feels creative and playful, not just functional.

      I was so satisfied with this lamp that I bought one for my sister, and I’m planning to get one for my parents as well. Great quality, great features, and amazing value for the price. Highly recommend.

    • Keshia
      5 out of 5 stars
      I'm 35 or 36 and I love this lamp ☺️🥰😅
      Reviewed in Canada on April 20, 2026
      Size: Small
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      😃🥰 This thing honestly cheers me up every day☺️ its only been 1 week and im still gushing over how cute and fun this lamp is😃

      PROS:

      • Clean, modern, smooth curves.

      I love that the branding logo is at least blended in nicely and not tacky.. pretty minimal. Not tacky.

      • I LOVE the DIY functions. Choosing your own colors from the color wheel is awesome. There are many colors to choose from ! #1 reason for buying this lamp was the DIY functions 🥰

      • Price was okay, but still a bit steep. I bought 2 for a total of 162$ ... (you got a deal if you bought 2)

      80 bucks is a bit steep still... even with all this lamp does. I would not pay more than 80 for this lamp... especially because it's not cordless like the updated one.

      • I love that they update the app with new options for preset scenes! I didn't even expect that and then I saw new ones appear one day.

      • I love that you can dim the background color in the DIY Sketch section. Helps a lot with night time chill time... plus looks great paired with bright colors in contrast to the dimmed background.

      I'm an adult female and I have so much fun playing with this lamp.

      All in all I LOVE this lamp. The cons/improvements I list below, are just me being very critical of the color limitation.

      CONS / Improvements

      • I wish you could get deeper colors.. like a deep striking red, a basic 'green crayon' green, a forest green... etc but it's just not possible.

      The greens are lime green to aqua.

      The reds aren't red, they are hot pink to coral pink even on the reddest setting.

      • The lamp is very bright, even on its lowest 1% setting. I can't have these on at night when I'm sleeping... which is kind of a bummer. Sometimes we have to turn them off when we're watching tv at night too, because theyre just so bright. Even the various sleep preset scenes that do have darker dimmed colors.. it's still quite bright.

      *** Correction though ... I found in the DIY Sketch that you can actually dim the main background color.

      Huge plus !

      Now night time wont be so bright and I can really make other colors pop against the dimmed background.

      • Wish it were cordless of course, but I am sure they will make a cordless version since they already did with the Table Lamp Pro JBL speaker one. Hopefully they keep these ones smaller like they are but make them cordless.

      • For the preset 'scene settings' ..... you can't actually change the colors to anything you want.

      For the ones you CAN customize (there are a few you 100% can not) There is a list of 8 different color "combos" to choose from. If you don't like a color used in any of those 8 color combos, you cant do anything about it.

      So for my favorite scene settings,

      I can only use that scene if I use one of the 8 pre set options provided for that scene.

      This is shown on one of my review photos.

      However, I have recreated some of the "preset scenes" using the DIY/Sketch function. That enables me to use whatever colors I choose.. but still there are limitations around this.

      For example, the "Fire" Preset Scene, you can't choose other colors for that fire movement scene at all. Which sucks. It would look very cool in other colors. *** EDIT --- I stand corrected after exploring some more. In the DIY section, you do have "fire" as an effect and you can change the color of it... including various colors it will morph into. It just doesnt show on the actual 'fire' preset scene. Very happy to have realized this ☺️

      • The Ai function is super cool.. and I know it works awesome on their other products such as their light panel or curtain lights... this one has limitations only because of the inability to use darker or duller color. For example in my last photo you can see I asked for a moody greyish blue sky... slate grey/slate dull blue would have been awesome with white clouds... but it can't do those colors (slate greyish blue). HOWEVER now that I know I can dim the background significantly in the DIY section, I can maybe pull this off.

      Finding a way to realllyy have "millions" of colors to choose from would be great. I'm being really picky here lol I do love the color options it does have. 😍🥰

      With most variations of any color on the DIY color wheel, outside of the most obvious variations, the difference is barely barely noticeable, even if on the app they show as very different shades or tints of blue, there is barely a difference once on the lamp...... Though there often IS a difference. You can see the slight change when you switch back and forth, for the most part.

      You get a lot of pink, since the entirety of the red are variations of pink.. plus the actual entire pink section. Much of the "purples" are actually fuschia pink. You have to go very blue to get a regular "purple".

      There are way less variations of green, purple, yellow. Green for example, there is only lime green and quickly goes to aqua, or yellow on the other side. Basic green crayon color would be awesome.

      Purple usually looks more blue or fuschia.. depending what colors you pair it with it or whether purple is totally by itself.

      Or if you dim the background color, your 'purple'(fuschia) will probably turn more towards actual purple.

      When I use a red background, (which shows hot hot reddish pink to orangey red.. never real red).... i can get a purple heart on it by making the heart blue. It then shows up purple. So there are tricks. ☺️

      I am really happy with the custom colors though despite these few limitations haha I'm making it sound worse than it is. It's an awesome lamp. 🥰

      I wish I could draw/sketch white and grey mountains... like light grey with contrasting dark grey and slate grey, with white tips mountains. I will play around with it some more though, because in the DIY "Fire" effect, I see some 'slate' greys possible be used. So it seems possible?

      Another example of this limitation:

      🎅🎄Christmas colors.. there are none.

      ... Since red is hot pink and green is lime green. So the preset christmas scenes do not give christmas vibes at all.

      Same with the Halloween... purple is never purple enough unless you have zero colors near it... or place enough blue next to fuschia to turn the fuschia a nice purple.

      The halloween presets that have orange and purple next to eachother, the purple never shows well enough to look Halloweeny. In my opinion.

      St Patricks Day Preset Scenes are capable of lime green only...

      Other than that,

      These lamps are so awesome. 😁

      I'm totally buying more Govee products 😏😛 I ordered the Uplighter off their website just days after I bought these lamps😛

      One small annoyance is I ordered from the Govee website 5 days ago and my uplighter still isnt here.

      I went through the website bc it was on sale for 170 + an extra 8$ off coupon code.......

      5 days later today the lamp is here on Amazon on sale for 160.....

      So I could have got the lamp within 24hrs had I been able to use Amazon but they lagged 5 days on matching their amazon store sale to their website sale. Hopefully it arrives today.

      GOVEE is where it's at it seems
      Reviewed in Canada on November 10, 2024
      Size: Small
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have several Govee products and I have watched a lot of growth over the years. What brought me back to

      Govee was not only their string lights, but the customer support is amazing. And they probably would win the popularity vote if there was one. Now it is getting to the point that when Govee releases another product, I want to buy it whether I need it or not. This table light is no exception! I wanted it just because it's Govee and who doesn't want a table side light that can do a heck of a lot more than just be a light. The scenes are amazing and there are so many to choose from. So not only can it be a white light that you can change the brightness but it can be programed to similate a sunrise when you get up or a sunset when you go to bed or any other combination in between.

      I had a night light with a smart bulb in it and was quite happy with it. But the Table light seemed like it would be the perfect companion. No matter what, I like this light, but there are a couple of things that could use help. This goes for just about every light strip that Govee has and it has to do with the music feature. For the most part it syncs well enough to most beats, but what bothers me and a ton of others is that when there is no sound, it still dances with light. So it's not exact. One day they will address this issue. The other issue that is not a problem for everyone, but certainly is for new people and even more so for older people who are not into apps and programing lights to do what they want it to. The presets are great, don't get me wrong, but there is a number of people that have issues in not knowing how to do even basic stuff. Don't be intimidated, there is plenty of support and plenty of communities who are willing to help. I just wish that Govee had their own How to Videos. But the growth has been amazing. I also think that prices are premium and they don't have to be. But once you bite down on the purchase, you will have a lot of fun with their products and for that reason I'm in.

    • David O
      5 out of 5 stars
      Good enough that we bought two, Govee app just keeps getting better
      Reviewed in Canada on August 12, 2026
      Size: Small
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have two of these lights in my office, and absolutely love how customisable the lamps are.

      The lamps include touch controls on top for on/off, brightness and cycling between basic scenes, but the Govee app really shines for these.

      The amount of scenes that come pre-loaded is great, and being able to browse user made scenes, create your own, and curate them with AI is just insane.

      I especially love that the lighting on these is seamless; there's no ugly LED band that appears on the lamp, and with enough tweaking, there's no lag on the scenes that change light colours.

      My only complaint is related to that lag, it's quite difficult finding a scene where the colours don't jitter a bit. However, of you stick to the basic scenes or just use the lamp as natural coloured light, it's ideal.

      It also gets very bright when using the lamp in the white colour temperature mode, and the lamp itself is really stylish and modern, the base is super cool.

      And lastly for people who like tech specs, it plugs in with a DC barrel jack, with a cable that's about 5 feet long. The lamp also has crazy comparability with Home Assistant via Govee Cloud add one, but I've not dove deep enough into that yet!
